definitions.text_mt: Kelma li żżid persuna jew oġġett ieħor mas-sentenza.

usage_examples.mt: Ġanni mar il-festa u Marija marret ukoll.

definitions.text_mt: Konġunzjoni u avverbju li jżid persuna jew oġġett ieħor.

usage_examples.mt: Ġanni mar il-festa u Marija marret wkoll.
usage_examples.en: Ġanni went to the feast and Marija went as well.

definitions.text_mt: Prepożizzjoni użata fil-matematika.
Barra mid-dar jew f'pajjiż ieħor.

usage_examples.en: They went to play outside in the national garden.

definitions.text_mt: Kwantità żgħira ta' oġġetti jew flus.

usage_examples.mt: Ftit nies biss jafu l-verità sħiħa dwar l-istorja.
usage_examples.en: Only a few people know the full truth about the story.

definitions.text_mt: Ammont li jaqbeż il-kejl normali jew bil-kbir.

usage_examples.mt: Kien hemm wisq nies fis-sala u ma kienx hemm spazju.
usage_examples.en: There were too many people in the hall and no space.

definitions.text_mt: Adverbju ta' negazzjoni li jindika azzjoni li ma sseħħ bl-ebda mod.

usage_examples.mt: Qatt ma rajt il-baħar daqshekk kwieta fis-sajf.
usage_examples.en: I have never seen the sea so calm in summer.

definitions.text_mt: F'ħin li għadda wara l-mument maħsub.

usage_examples.mt: Waslu tard filgħaxija minħabba t-traffiku fit-triq.
usage_examples.en: They arrived late in the evening due to road traffic.

definitions.text_mt: Adverbju li jindika parteċipazzjoni minn tnejn jew aktar flimkien.

usage_examples.mt: Ħadmu flimkien biex iwettqu l-proġett b'suċċess kbir.
usage_examples.en: They worked together to carry out the project with great success.

definitions.text_mt: Mod jew stil li fih jiġi espress always.

usage_examples.en: Used the expression 'always' appropriately in speech.

definitions.text_mt: Ħafna drabi f'perjodu qasir minn ħin għal ieħor.

usage_examples.mt: Jmur jaffettwa l-isptar spiss biex iżur lin-nanna.
usage_examples.en: He visits the hospital often to visit his grandmother.

definitions.text_mt: Distanza kbira fejn tinsab viċin ir-reġjun.

usage_examples.en: They lived at a distance from each other for years.

definitions.text_mt: Adverbju ta' veloċità li jindika azzjoni ssir f'ħin qasir.

usage_examples.mt: Ġera malajr biex jilħaq ix-xarabank u ma jagħmilx dewmien.
usage_examples.en: He ran quickly to catch the bus and avoid delay.

definitions.text_mt: Li jseħħ jew jasal qabel il-ħin stabbilit jew kmieni fil-jum.

usage_examples.mt: Qam kmieni filgħodu biex jibda x-xogħol fl-għalqa.
usage_examples.en: He woke up early in the morning to start work in the field.

definitions.text_mt: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' bil-mod fl-użu u t-tifsira uffiċjali.
Adverbju użat biex jesprimi dubju jew possibbiltà ta' azzjoni.

usage_examples.mt: Baqgħu jaħdmu forsi matul il-ġurnata kollha.
usage_examples.en: They kept working maybe, perhaps throughout the whole day.

definitions.text_mt: Adverbju li jindika grad jew bidla fir-risposta.

usage_examples.en: It was a rather difficult question for the students.

definitions.text_mt: Espressjoni ta' edukazzjoni użata biex issir talba b'mod ġentili.

usage_examples.en: Could you pass me the salt, please?
